description: Safety-tier registry (docs/SPEC-hospital.md 6.3). The FhirGateway refuses writes from a module without an entry here or outside its writes_allowed; the signing service reads required_signoff_role. WP4b (6.4) moves these fields into the agent registry (config/agents/<agent_id>.yaml): tier -> risk_tier, required_signoff_role and consent_required unchanged, writes_allowed -> allowed_tools.

control_tower.purpose: Hospital flow: bed board, exceptions and recommended actions (7.1)

registration.purpose: Registration desk: demographics, proposed appointments, registration tasks

consent_management.purpose: Records a patient's consent decisions (6.3 consent management)

bedside_nursing.purpose: Nursing work items: tasks, safety flags, communications

discharge_summary.purpose: Discharge summary draft from the FHIR record (7.3)

medication_reconciliation.purpose: Medication reconciliation differences, co-signed by pharmacist and physician (7.2)

order_review.purpose: Order and medication safety review comments (7.2)

followup_calls.purpose: Post-discharge follow-up calls; red flags escalate to a nurse (7.4)

patient_messaging.purpose: SMS reminders and messages to patients
